title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React / Python)
highlight: Build next-generation Human-in-the-Loop review workbenches combining Next.js, FastAPI, and real-time AI workflows
overview:
We are building a next-generation Human-in-the-Loop Risk Intelligence Platform that combines AI, document understanding, and real-time review workflows. The platform helps enterprises process, analyze, and validate complex documents through a review workbench powered by modern web technologies and AI-driven insights.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep React and TypeScript skills who enjoys building high-performance, data-intensive, interactive web applications.

stack.Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PostgreSQL, Redis
stack.AI/ML Services: FastAPI, Pydantic, OpenAI, Qdrant vector database

responsibilities: Build and scale complex web applications using Next.js, React and TypeScript
Develop interactive document review and annotation interfaces
Design scalable frontend architecture and state management
Build and extend backend APIs in FastAPI with PostgreSQL
Integrate the frontend with backend and AI/ML services
Work with async processing (SQS workers), caching (Redis) and file storage (S3)
Collaborate with AI/ML and backend teams to deliver intelligent user workflows
Optimize performance for large datasets and real-time interactions
requirements: 4+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
Proven experience building complex, production-grade web applications
Strong understanding of state management (Redux, Zustand, Context API, or similar)
Experience building or integrating REST APIs; Python/FastAPI preferred
Working knowledge of SQL databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
Solid grasp of frontend performance optimization (rendering, large datasets, memoization, virtualization)
Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset

title: Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer
highlight: Own cloud environment end-to-end, enforce strict US data residency, and lead SOC 2 Type II certification for Cosmos One
overview:
Cosmos One is a cloud-based legal software platform for Florida property insurance defense attorneys. It processes confidential case documents using AI and requires strict security, data privacy, and compliance controls throughout.

This is our first dedicated infrastructure hire. You will own the cloud environment end-to-end: design, security, deployment, and ongoing operations. You will work directly alongside a full-stack engineer and an AI engineer.

You will also lead our path to SOC 2 Type II certification (a formal third-party security audit required by enterprise legal clients).
responsibilities: Cloud Infrastructure: Set up and manage our cloud environment on AWS or Azure. All data must remain in US regions (a legal requirement for our clients)
Cloud Infrastructure: Ensure complete separation between law firm accounts. No data from one client can ever be accessible by another
Cloud Infrastructure: Manage encryption of all data, both stored and in transit; own the encryption key lifecycle including key rotation and secure deletion when a case closes
Cloud Infrastructure: Design file storage for legal documents, including a 7-year retention requirement for clients not using their own document management system
Cloud Infrastructure: Define our disaster recovery plan: how quickly we can restore service after an outage, and how much data we can afford to lose
Deployment & Automation: Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) with security checks built in at every stage
Deployment & Automation: Define all infrastructure in code using Terraform or AWS Cloud Development Kit (no manual cloud console configuration)
Deployment & Automation: Set up monitoring, alerting, and logging so we can detect and respond to incidents quickly
Deployment & Automation: Manage our integrations with third-party AI model providers; ensure vendor contracts prohibit training on our client data
Security & Compliance: Lead our SOC 2 Type II readiness program: gap analysis, control documentation, evidence collection, and working with external auditors
Security & Compliance: Own our incident response plan, including the 30-day breach notification requirement
Security & Compliance: Implement an immutable audit log: every attorney approval is recorded and cannot be altered after the fact
Security & Compliance: Review and approve all third-party vendors against our security and data residency requirements
Security & Compliance: Conduct regular security reviews and manage vulnerability patching
requirements: 5–8 years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and security experience
Strong AWS or Azure experience in production, multi-tenant Software-as-a-Service environments
Experience defining infrastructure in code (Terraform and/or AWS Cloud Development Kit)
Hands-on experience building automated deployment pipelines with integrated security scanning
Has been through at least one SOC 2 Type II audit, ideally as the primary infrastructure owner
Solid grasp of encryption: key management, key rotation, and enforcing data residency
Experience with regulated data environments: legal, healthcare, or financial services
Clear written communication. An early deliverable is a Security and Infrastructure Plan that must be approved before development begins
